source_refs.note: 'Unsupervised Machine Learning' under topic 6.4, as printed (PDF 80, printed 76).

blocks.text: Unsupervised machine learning works with unlabeled data. The system finds patterns without guidance. It groups similar data together and makes clusters. This method is useful for discovering hidden structures. No correct output is provided. Learning depends on data similarity. Unsupervised learning helps understand data behavior. It is useful for data exploration. Examples include customer grouping and data clustering.
